fields.Name: IT04 - RecordSetProcessor Substrate
fields.Description: Exercises the RecordSetProcessor substrate end-to-end against the live DB (deterministic — a FunctionRecordProcessor, no model calls). RP1: a 3-record run persists an MJ: Process Runs header + one terminal MJ: Process Run Details per record (fire-and-forget tracker writes land + carry CompletedAt). RP2: mixed success/error/skip counts are recorded accurately. RP3: a processor that throws isolates the bad record (Error) and still persists every detail. RP4: the error-rate circuit breaker trips (Status=Failed, processed < total). RP5: a run spanning multiple batches processes every record. RP6: bounded concurrency runs in parallel but never exceeds maxConcurrency. RP7/RP8: dry-run persists DryRun=1 vs a normal apply persists DryRun=0 (history can tell a preview from an apply). The substrate's own ProcessRun/Detail audit rows are its output and are left in place.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Runs persist accurate Process Run headers + one terminal Process Run Detail per record; counts, isolation, circuit breaker, batching, concurrency cap, and the DryRun flag all behave as specified.
